title: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027
last_action: House Armed Services processed the bill in June; House Rules met June 29 and July 20. AI-related floor amendments were considered, including a Buchanan reporting amendment agreed by voice.
summary: The principal House defense-authorization vehicle and a likely landing zone for military AI safeguards, procurement security, model-security reporting, and AI Security Center provisions.
committee_dynamics: Must-pass status gives the vehicle strong momentum, but individual AI provisions may be added, narrowed, traded, or removed during floor and conference negotiations.
advance_rationale: Annual NDAA enactment pressure and active floor processing make material AI-security movement likely.
verification_level: Primary-source verified in the September 1, 2026 research pass
